name: tinte
tagline_zh: 当用户说“换个主题”，别再瞎猜色号。tinte 直接浏览、安装、预览设计系统，兼容 shadcn v4。
tagline_en: When users say 'change theme,' stop guessing hex codes. tinte browses, installs, previews design systems—shadcn.
desc_en: Agent-native design system infrastructure. Browse, install, and preview design systems from tinte.dev. Use when user asks about themes, design systems, presets, color palettes, or says "tinte". Works with shadcn/cli v4 presets and registries.
why_zh: 同类工具只给代码片段，tinte 是完整设计系统基础设施，能预览再装，且原生对接 shadcn v4 。
why_en: Unlike snippet-only tools, tinte is full design-system infra: preview before install, natively wired to shadcn v4 registries.
